page: Microsoft Azure EC32as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance driven by AMD x86_64 processors on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs combined with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding an expansive ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It operates strictly on central processing power, containing zero hardware acceleration GPUs.

For disk operations, the EC32as_v6 features no bundled local ephemeral storage. It relies on external storage integrations and is Premium Storage capable. This diskless configuration directs all storage throughput to managed network volumes, requiring external provisioning for OS and data files while mitigating the risk of data loss associated with temporary local disks.

By delivering a high volume of memory per compute unit without the cost overhead of attached local NVMe drives or discrete GPUs, the instance provides efficient resource scaling for memory-bound tasks. The EC32as_v6 is suited for large relational database management systems, in-memory caching solutions, enterprise resource planning platforms, and big data analytics pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure EC32as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by AMD x86_64 processors on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a high 8.0 GB per vCPU memory density. The instance includes no GPU acceleration and does not bundle local disk storage, depending instead on network-attached Premium Storage for persistent I/O operations. This diskless hardware structure eliminates unused local storage overhead while maintaining high memory capacity per core. Consequently, the EC32as_v6 offers an efficient compute-to-memory profile designed for memory-intensive workloads, including enterprise in-memory caches, large transactional databases, and real-time data processing engines.
